```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

```

# Morphometic analysis
```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import

jpg.list <- list.files("outlines", pattern=c( ".jpg"), full.names=TRUE) 

# import them

spores <- Momocs::import_jpg(jpg.paths = jpg.list, auto.notcentered = T)
out_spores <- Momocs::Out(spores)
out_spores <- Momocs::coo_center(out_spores)
out_spores_scaled <- Momocs::coo_scale(out_spores)
out_spores_smoothed <- Momocs::coo_smooth(out_spores_scaled, n = 5)
# Ensure all outlines have the same number of points (e.g., 100 points per outline)
out_spores_interp <- Momocs::coo_interpolate(out_spores_smoothed, n = 120)
# Now apply Procrustes alignment
out_spores_aligned <- Momocs::fgProcrustes(out_spores_interp)
# Visualize to confirm
panel(out_spores_aligned, title = "Aligned Amanita Spores after Resampling")
efourier_spores <- Momocs::efourier(out_spores_scaled, nb.h = 10, norm = TRUE)
pca_spores <- Momocs::PCA(efourier_spores)

```
# Volume (size) analysis


```{r}
# Load the spore volume data
volume_data <- read_csv("spreadsheets/Sporelengthwidthvolume.csv")

# View the first few rows to confirm it's loaded correctly
head(volume_data)

```

# clean pca data and prep for data merge
```{r}
# Extract PCA scores and add species names if available
pca_scores_df_species <- as.data.frame(pca_spores$x)  # PCA scores
pca_scores_df_species$species <- rownames(pca_scores_df_species) # Add species as a column if not already
head(pca_scores_df_species)
write.csv(pca_scores_df_species, file = "PCA_Spore_Scores_Species.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```


```{r}
# Standardize species names in PCA dataset (e.g., Amanita_abrupta_Bas_1 -> A_abrupta)
pca_scores_df_species <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  mutate(species = str_replace(species, "Amanita_", "A_"),     # Replace 'Amanita_' with 'A_'
         species = str_extract(species, "^A_[a-z]+"))          # Keep only 'A_speciesname'

# Check results
unique(pca_scores_df_species$species)

```
```{r}
# Aggregate PCA scores by species using summarise_at (alternative to across)
pca_agg <- pca_scores_df_species %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(starts_with("PC")), mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Check the aggregated PCA scores
head(pca_agg)

```
```{r}
volume_data <- volume_data %>%
  mutate(species = str_replace(species, "Amanita_", "A_"),    # In case full names are used
         species = str_extract(species, "^A_[a-z]+"))         # Keep 'A_species' format

# Check species names after standardization
unique(volume_data$species)


```
# data merge 
```{r}
# Merge the PCA and volume datasets
merged_data <- inner_join(pca_agg, volume_data, by = "species")

# View the merged dataset
head(merged_data)

```

# visualize merged data

```{r}

# Correlation test
cor_test_result <- cor.test(merged_data$estimated_volume, merged_data$PC1)
cor_coef <- round(cor_test_result$estimate, 3)   # Correlation coefficient
p_value <- signif(cor_test_result$p.value, 3)    # p-value

# Linear regression model
lm_model <- lm(PC1 ~ estimated_volume, data = merged_data)
lm_summary <- summary(lm_model)
r_squared <- round(lm_summary$r.squared, 3)      # R-squared
slope <- round(coef(lm_model)[2], 3)             # Slope
intercept <- round(coef(lm_model)[1], 3)         # Intercept
```




```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Identify the point with the lowest spore volume (X-axis)
lowest_volume_point <- merged_data %>%
  filter(estimated_volume == min(estimated_volume))

# Identify the point with the lowest PC1 score (Y-axis)
lowest_PC1_point <- merged_data %>%
  filter(PC1 == min(PC1))

# Identify the top-right point (max volume and PC1)
top_right_point <- merged_data %>%
  filter(estimated_volume == max(estimated_volume) & PC1 == max(PC1))

# Enhanced plot with separate min labels and top-right label
ggplot(merged_data, aes(x = estimated_volume, y = PC1)) +
  geom_point(color = "darkorange", size = 4, alpha = 0.7, shape = 16) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "steelblue", size = 1.5) +
  
  # Regression and correlation annotations
  annotate(
    "text", x = max(merged_data$estimated_volume) * 0.6,
    y = max(merged_data$PC1) * 0.9,
    label = paste0(
      "Correlation (r): ", round(cor.test(merged_data$estimated_volume, merged_data$PC1)$estimate, 3), "\n",
      "p-value: ", signif(cor.test(merged_data$estimated_volume, merged_data$PC1)$p.value, 3), "\n",
      "R²: ", round(summary(lm(PC1 ~ estimated_volume, data = merged_data))$r.squared, 3)
    ),
    size = 4, hjust = 0, color = "black"
  ) +

  # Label the point with the lowest spore volume (X-axis)
  geom_label(
    data = lowest_volume_point, aes(label = species),
    nudge_x = -0.05 * max(merged_data$estimated_volume),
    nudge_y = 0.05 * max(merged_data$PC1),
    color = "black", fill = "lightgreen", size = 3
  ) +

  # Label the point with the lowest PC1 score (Y-axis)
  geom_label(
    data = lowest_PC1_point, aes(label = species),
    nudge_x = 0.05 * max(merged_data$estimated_volume),
    nudge_y = -0.05 * max(merged_data$PC1),
    color = "black", fill = "lightpink", size = 3
  ) +

  # Label the top-right point (max volume and PC1)
  geom_label(
    data = top_right_point, aes(label = species),
    nudge_x = 0.05 * max(merged_data$estimated_volume),
    nudge_y = 0.05 * max(merged_data$PC1),
    color = "black", fill = "lightblue", size = 3
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "PC1 (Spore Shape) vs. Spore Volume",
    x = "Estimated Spore Volume (µm³)",
    y = "PC1 Score (Shape Variation)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )

```
